task: Assess the credit and counterparty risk of Carvana

nimble.claim: Carvana Co. (NYSE: CVNA) is a founder-controlled 'controlled company' with dual-class shares: the Garcia family controls roughly 85% of voting power via super-voting Class B shares; Ernie Garcia III is Chairman and CEO; Ernest Garcia II is the largest individual shareholder (~7% economic stake) and controls related companies DriveTime and Bridgecrest; Vanguard and BlackRock are largest institutional holders; no PE sponsor, no recent change of control (as of 2026-10-20).
Carvana Co. net sales and operating revenues were $7,376 million in Q2 2026 (three months ended 2026-06-30), up 52% YoY.
Carvana Co. net sales and operating revenues were $13,808 million for the six months ended 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. GAAP net income was $513 million in Q2 2026 (7.0% net income margin, an all-time quarterly record).
Carvana Co. Adjusted EBITDA was $769 million in Q2 2026 (10.4% margin, record).
Carvana Co. had cash and cash equivalents of $2,630 million as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. had total debt of $5,133 million as of 2026-06-30 (total liabilities $9,414M including a $2,130M tax receivable agreement liability).
Carvana Co. net cash provided by operating activities was $345 million for the six months ended 2026-06-30.

Carvana Co. entered a new short-term revolving credit facility in Q2 2026 to fund finance receivables through November 2027 (size not disclosed); management states working capital, operating cash flow and expected financing are sufficient to fund operations for at least one year.
Carvana Co. Adjusted EBITDA for full year 2025 was $2,240 million.
Carvana Co. issued FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.7-$3.0 billion on 2026-07-29.

On 2026-08-14 Carvana Co. entered a $1.66 billion senior secured Term Loan B maturing 2033-08-14, priced at 99.75% of par, at Term SOFR+2.25%, 0.25% quarterly amortization, 50% excess cash flow sweep from FY2028, guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries and secured by substantially all collateral, with no financial covenant.
Carvana Co. used Term Loan B proceeds to redeem its 9.0%/11.0%/13.0% Cash/PIK Senior Secured Notes due 2030: $1.0 billion redeemed 2026-08-15 and the remainder 2026-08-22.

Carvana Co. transitioned to fully cash-paying interest in August 2025, a $1.26 billion equity offering partially funded voluntary debt reduction, unrestricted cash was ~$1.86 billion at 2025-06-30, and debt/EBITDA improved to ~3.2x for the 12 months ended 2025-06-30.
Carvana Co. recorded ~$320 million of non-cash PIK interest in the period ended 2025-06-30.

In August 2023 Carvana Co. launched an out-of-court restructuring exchanging 5.500% 2027, 5.875% 2028, 4.875% 2029 and 10.250% 2030 unsecured notes for up to $4.275 billion of new Cash/PIK senior secured notes due 2028/2030/2031, with holders of more than 90% of unsecured notes committed to participate.
In August 2023 Carvana Co. launched a $425.0 million cash tender offer for its 5.625% 2025 notes at 85% of par, with consent solicitations stripping covenants.
Fitch Ratings assigned Carvana Co. a first-time Issuer Default Rating of 'BB-' with Stable Outlook on 2026-07-30.
Moody's upgraded Carvana's corporate family rating to B2 from B3 with positive outlook on 2025-10-02; senior secured notes to B2 from B3 and senior unsecured notes to Caa1 from Caa2.

Moody's (Oct 2025) cited Carvana's ~$985M LTM gains on receivables sales and debt/EBITDA ~3.2x, noted its good-liquidity assessment depends on continued ability to sell receivables for significant gains, and said further upgrade needs debt/EBITDA below 4.0x and EBITDA-capex/interest above 3.0x.
Moody's upgraded Carvana's CFR to B3 from Caa1 (PDR B3-PD, SGL-2) with positive outlook on 2025-03-27; debt/EBITDA improved to ~4.2x at FYE2024 from ~18.8x at FYE2023.

S&P Global Ratings upgraded Carvana to 'B' from 'B-' (senior secured 'B', senior unsecured 'CCC+') with positive outlook on 2025-03-14; further upgrade possible if leverage stays below 5x and FOCF/debt above 5%.
Carvana Co. has a $1 billion at-the-market equity facility after raising $1.3 billion via ATM in 2024 and redeeming $470 million of 2028 senior secured notes in 2024.

On 2026-01-28 short seller Gotham City Research accused Carvana of overstating 2023-2024 earnings by more than $1 billion and of undisclosed dependence on related parties DriveTime and Bridgecrest; CVNA shares fell 14.2% to $410.04; Carvana called the report inaccurate and misleading.
On 2026-02-20 Carvana CFO Mark Jenkins refuted short-seller related-party disclosure allegations as '100% inaccurate' on the Q4 2025 earnings call; no CFO departure or auditor change reported.
Hindenburg Research disclosed a short position in Carvana on 2025-01-02, calling the turnaround a 'mirage' propped up by unstable loans and accounting manipulation.
Carvana cut ~2,500 employees (~12% of workforce) in 2022 and a further ~1,500 (~8%) in November 2022 as used-car sales fell.

On 2025-01-14 the Connecticut Attorney General announced a $1.5 million settlement with Carvana over title/registration delays, delayed payments to sellers, delayed loan payoffs and vehicle condition misrepresentations: $1 million restitution fund plus $500,000 penalty ($250,000 suspended on compliance).

exa.claim: Carvana Co. is publicly listed (NYSE: CVNA) and Garcia-family controlled; the Garcia Parties held approximately 83% of voting power at December 31, 2025, per the 2025 Form 10-K.
Carvana Co. revenue was $7.376 billion for the three months ended 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. GAAP operating income was $680 million for the three months ended 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) was $769 million for the three months ended 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. had cash and cash equivalents of $2.630 billion as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. had restricted cash of $113 million (separate from cash and cash equivalents) as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. total debt per Note 9 was $5.133 billion as of 2026-06-30, excluding finance leases.
Carvana Co. had finance lease liabilities of $118 million as of 2026-06-30, separate from Note 9 debt.
Carvana Co. had a tax receivable agreement liability of $2.130 billion as of 2026-06-30, separate from debt.
Carvana Co. had $2.039 billion availability under revolving facilities based on pledgeable assets as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. had $4.669 billion of committed liquidity resources available, including cash, as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. had $7.024 billion of total liquidity resources as of 2026-06-30, including conditional additional debt capacity and unpledged securities.
Carvana Co. net cash provided by operating activities was $345 million for the six months ended 2026-06-30.

On 2026-08-14 Carvana Co. entered a $1.66 billion senior secured Term Loan B due 2033-08-14, issued at 99.75, at Term SOFR+2.25% (or base rate+1.25%), with proceeds to refinance all 2030 secured notes (redemptions August 15 and 22) and quarterly amortization of 0.25% of original principal; a refinancing, not a distressed exchange.

Carvana Co. management estimated (2026-08-12) the Term Loan B refinancing would reduce annual cash interest by about $45 million over the next four years on a leverage-neutral basis; a company estimate, not realized savings.
Carvana Co. reported compliance with all debt covenants as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. Note 9 reports $319 million of current debt principal (excluding finance leases) as of 2026-06-30.
Carvana Co. has $32 million of unsecured notes due April 15, 2027.
In May 2026 Carvana Co. added a $500 million finance-receivable revolving facility through November 8, 2027.
A March 2026 amendment increased another Carvana Co. finance-receivable facility to $600 million and extended its maturity to June 30, 2027.
Carvana Co. aggregate finance-receivable facilities had $4.1 billion of unused capacity at June 30, 2026, though collateral-based immediately available borrowing is lower.
Carvana Co. completed exchange offers in September 2023 resulting in senior secured debt; historical liability-management context, not a new event.
On 2026-03-03 S&P affirmed Carvana Co.'s issuer credit rating at BB- with Positive outlook, upgraded the senior secured issue rating to BB from BB-, and affirmed the senior unsecured rating at B.
On 2026-06-24 Moody's upgraded Carvana Co.'s long-term foreign-currency rating to B1 from B2 with Positive outlook (as reported by Cbonds).
On 2026-07-30 Fitch assigned Carvana Co. a first-time long-term issuer default rating of BB-; outlook unverified.

Carvana Co.'s June 2026 Form 10-Q states management expects working capital, operating cash flow and expected continued or new financing to fund operations for at least one year from issuance (conditional guidance).
Carvana Co. accrual for unresolved legal matters was $10 million at 2026-06-30, versus $14 million at December 31, 2025.

Grant Thornton LLP (auditor since 2015) issued an unqualified opinion on Carvana Co.'s 2025 financial statements and effective internal control over financial reporting, with no going-concern qualification identified.
Carvana Co. scheduled Q3 2026 results for October 28, 2026, so the latest quarterly financials available are for June 30, 2026.

The Connecticut Attorney General announced a $1.5 million settlement with Carvana (2025-01-14) over consumer complaints including delayed seller payments, delayed loan payoffs and title/registration delays; $1 million restitution and $500,000 penalty ($250,000 suspended if conditions met); investigation began January 2022.
